note: Niche discovery queue. It is empty on purpose: the eligibility filter is sourced from Amazon's published rate table, but the demand-ranking input requires an authenticated catalog feed. Publishing a shortlist of 'profitable niches' without that input would be exactly the invention this project forbids, so zero rows are emitted and the state is recorded here.
blocking_reason: no authorized demand/sales-rank data source connected (Creators API requires an Associates account with >=10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days)

eligibility_filter.description: Deterministic, sourced, and applied before any ranking: a category in the published 0.00% bands can never enter the queue.
excluded_bands: Digital Kindle Products purchased as a subscription
Food prepared and delivered from a restaurant
Amazon Appstore, Prime Now, or Amazon Pay Places

ranking_inputs_required.source: published rate table (S04) transcribed in data/commission_table.json

ranking_inputs_required.input: catalog demand / sales-rank trajectory over >=2 dated snapshots
listing review depth and rating for candidate ASINs
ranking_inputs_required.source: Creators API item data only, per the License (S02)

row_schema.niche: string - category or sub-category label taken from a catalog record, never invented
row_schema.score: computed by tools/scoring.py::niche_score - null until every input exists
row_schema.source_ids: array of ids in data/sources.json - required

empty_state_message: 0 niches published. The queue fills only when the catalog feed is connected; no niche is declared profitable here.
